projects.title: Berlin's Nights
projects.description: The city after dark — high contrast, hard shadows, and the people who live in them.

photos.alt: A pedestrian with an umbrella blurs across a rain-soaked Ku'damm crossing at night, a lit department store behind.
A man in silhouette carries bags out through a bright doorway, long shadows fanning across the floor toward the camera.
A tram rounds a curve on a dark Berlin street, streetlights receding into the distance along the rails.

projects.title: Streets
projects.description: Strangers, photographed politely. Unstaged moments from Berlin and beyond.

photos.alt: A cyclist rides over a checkerboard-painted street into low, blinding sunlight between old buildings.
An older street musician in a hat plays saxophone on a stool as an older man walks past on the cobblestones.
A young woman gently touches the cheek of an older woman in glasses in a narrow doorway.
Three small children stand at the water's edge on a bright, almost white beach.
Travellers in silhouette cross the hall of Rotterdam Centraal beneath the station's glass facade and mirrored lettering.

projects.title: Potatoes and More
projects.description: Life in loud color. Vegetables may appear. Viewer discretion advised.

photos.alt: A man lies on sacks of potatoes in the back of a turquoise van, looking up at the camera, with more sacks on the ground in front.
A yellow U-Bahn train rushes past a station poster of people lounging in swimwear.
A woman in a swimsuit walks across a dry field under a white umbrella, a striped towel in her hand, parked cars behind.
